Identification.LongTitle: An Act to amend the Criminal Code (Corinne's Quest and the protection of children)
Identification.RunningHead: An Act to amend the Criminal Code (Corinne's Quest and the protection of children)

Provision.Text: This enactment amends the Criminal Code to repeal a provision that authorizes the correction of a child by force if certain criteria are met.
Her Majesty, by and with the advice and consent of the Senate and House of Commons of Canada, enacts as follows:

Section.Text: Section 43 of the Criminal Code is repealed.
